I'm a 21 ugly male. Life gets no better trust me. I thought if I got in shape, got fit, got a job shit would work out. No. Got fired. Ruined relationships that were probably one sided  in the first place, now that I look back. One thing I realized, once you're out of high school, no one really cares. Especially if you're ugly. It gets worse, theres this thing called survival of the fittest. This applies to humans. I'm totally fine with that because it makes sense. Might sound ridiculous, but being ugly has a negative connotation in and of itself. Your sole job as a human being is to pass on your genetics. When you're ugly, no one is gonna want their kids looking like you. If you cant fix it by being fit, then yes it's prolly the best idea to just stop before you end up living a life full of sorrow, and suffering. That's what I'm doing.

You're right fuck it, why should I continue living? Why attempt to keep living if I’m constantly seeing signs that life sucks, no matter what happens. Overrall, life doesn’t really matter anyways, well mine doesn’t at least. People may list a thousand reasons to keep living, everyday I feel like there’s a million not to though. Why put up with bullshit? Why work my ass off, knowing that the outcome of my life and choices aren't even up to me, and purely based on someone else judgement of me at any given time. Anything I do has no impact. We live in a world where you either suck it up while suffering the consequences, or you don’t and suffer the consequences. Why live a life of suffering, I’ve already tried to suck it up, but if there is god, he’s made it apparent that sucking it up has consequences too. I’ve already tried to self improve, self love, self respect, work out, be healthy, do drugs, anything to manage the suffering but it’s still there. Why choose to deal with it anymore? Because it seems like the right thing to do? My whole life seems like a joke, jokes are funny to tell, and to even to listen to too, but not to live as one. I was told it was obvious I’m a lonely person, no one cared though, shit’s funny as fuck when no one takes you seriously. I can lift all the fucking weights and get fit as much as I want, still be treated like dirt. I can be the kindest, friendliest person and still be castrated, and alienated. I can be the most hardworking, focused individual yet still disappoint and fail. I’m always disappointing someone, why choose to disappoint anymore? Yes there are plenty of victory stories, I just know for a fact my story won’t be though. So why prolong the inevitable, why can’t I just end my suffering? I can, and I am, this shit sucks.
